# .github/

## Subdirectories

| Directory | What | When to read |
| --------- | ---- | ------------ |
| `workflows/` | CI and publish GitHub Actions workflows | Configure CI pipeline or release process |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` | Bug report and feature request issue templates | Modify issue templates |

## Files

| File | What | When to read |
| ---- | ---- | ------------ |
| `dependabot.yml` | Grouped weekly updates for docs npm, NuGet, and GitHub Actions | Change how dependency and security PRs are opened |
